summary: Iteration 71 — Validated origin-aware tools, 52-country incentive registry, and GEO answer layer. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passed (incentives list + 4 covered + non-covered Benin; duty lookup US & India; hsn finder US & India; next-steps for duty/incentives/buyers with non-India origin; answers index/md tool/md guide/html canonical/404; sitemap includes /api/answers/html/). Frontend: Export Incentive Finder shows duty-export-support card (3 US schemes with authority + outbound https links); CountryIncentiveMap lists 54 tiles, search filters, DE tile expands to show Hermes Cover + inward/outward processing with authorities & official links. Duty Calculator: India origin (100630→276) shows RoDTEP exportBenefit AND Export support in India card; US origin (847130→124) shows no RoDTEP and the US export-support card. HSN Finder: US origin renders hsn-0-origin-support linking to /tools/export-incentive-finder?hs=847130&from=842&to=124; India origin renders hsn-0-origin-benefit with RoDTEP/Appendix 4R text. Landed Cost page copy mentions 'set your own export and import countries'. Mobile 390x844 has 0px horizontal overflow on all three tool pages. No India-only wording on non-India origin pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Incentive country list uses 'schemes' as integer count in list view but 'schemes' as array in detail view — same key, different type. Consider renaming the count field to 'schemeCount' for clarity.
Transient 502 observed once on /api/incentives/countries during the first run; passed on retry. Monitor edge-platform cold-start latency.
